name: grow-your-value
description: Two scores for an engineering leader or developer who wants to earn more. VMS (Value Multiplicator Score): twelve weighted steps give your market value from 0.4 to 1.7 and the three steps that raise it most. Digital footprint score: give it a LinkedIn profile URL and it scores how you look to a recruiter, a hiring manager or an AI screening tool, from public evidence only, with a plan. Then the LinkedIn profile boost advisor rewrites your profile section by section.
